sections.description: We invite entrepreneur-educationists, academicians, teachers, tutors, book sellers, or those engaged in any activity related to academics to look at our Academia Education WordPress Theme. This theme has been designed to cater to academicians as well as non-academicians engaged in academic related products/services and looking to create an online presence. Versatility of features and functions provided in the theme will equip students, faculty, and administrators to share information about their services and products. We’ve provided built-in support for tutors, and easy course management and creation. It is a responsive design; plus the template has been optimized for speed and search engines. It is user-friendly template, with the drag-and-drop feature. Its easy editing feature enables even a non-technical person to maintain it without any difficulty or extra expense. This theme is suitable for schools or institution where multiple people participate and manage day to day content updates and schedules. Academia Education WordPress theme is compatible with education tools, management apps, and plugins. It is scalable, meaning as you grow and get more traffic and enquiries; the band width will automatically increase and adjust to ensure your online institution functions seamlessly without any break down or technical glitches. If you need help, our design team is always there to offer email support. We will share technical updates regularly to ensure Academia Education WordPress Theme stays relevant as technology evolves. Through the easy to use Dashboard you can customize the look and feel by uploading your logo, images of your school, change fonts and background colors etc. to sync the look with your brand image. The theme has been professionally designed to ensure it meets all the requirements of client engaged in the academic and education profession. Sticky header, well placed action buttons, well divided sections give it a neat look.
